summary: Full-stack testing of the new Asisten AI (Claude via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) feature in TWMS. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases passed covering auth guard (401 w/o session), /assistant/history shape, SSE streaming /assistant/chat with persisted user+assistant records in chronological order, and DELETE /assistant/history. Frontend: Playwright flow (admin/admin123 login → dashboard regression OK) passed all 7 requested checks — sidebar nav-asisten present, /asisten loads with assistant-page + empty state + 4 suggestion chips, typing+send streams a Claude answer that mentions stok/gudang, user bubble is right-aligned (flex-row-reverse) and assistant bubble is left-aligned, 'Hapus Riwayat' button appears after first exchange, history persists on page reload, clearing returns to empty state, suggestion chip also triggers a streamed answer. No 503 / 'kunci tidak tersedia' / 'Asisten sedang tidak dapat dihubungi' errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Asisten.tsx uses hardcoded fetch('/api/assistant/chat') for streaming instead of REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Works here because Vite proxies /api, but it bypasses the project's apiGet/apiDelete helper and will break if the frontend is ever served from a different origin than the backend. Consider centralising the streaming fetch to use the configured base URL.

assistant.py build_data_context() runs on every chat request including 6 Mongo queries + full stock recompute; for warehouses with large collections this will add latency/cost per message. Consider short TTL cache keyed by DB mtime or last transaction id.

The chat endpoint persists only the final answer AFTER the stream completes; if the client disconnects mid-stream the exchange is silently lost (user sees partial text, nothing saved). Consider persisting incremental or finalising in a finally block tied to request cancellation.
SUGGESTIONS.indexOf(s) inside .map in Asisten.tsx is O(n^2) — negligible for 4 items but should just use the map index.
seed_data_creation: None — assistant answered from existing live DB (gudang PJM, negative stok noted by the model but that's a seed-data condition, not a bug).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_assistant.py (4 tests, ~8s, includes SSE streaming). Session cookie is named 'session' and httpx.Client stores it automatically. The assistant streams tokens via SSE lines of form `data: {"token": "..."}` ending with `{"done": true}` and only writes to Mongo after StreamDone; empty-stream errors emit `{"error": ...}`. The frontend streaming fetch is hardcoded to '/api/assistant/chat' (relative) — Playwright tests must therefore run against the preview URL (same-origin), which they do.
